title: Water treatment: book the free in-home water analysis
web_intro: You're the setter for a water-treatment dealer. A homeowner asked about a free water test. You'll hear 5 situations. Answer each one out loud, in English, like a real call (20–60 seconds).
goal_html: Goal: book the free in-home water analysis with both decision makers present.
wa_intro:
I'll be a *homeowner* who asked about a free water test. You are the setter for a water-treatment company.

Answer each message with a *VOICE NOTE* in English, like you're on the phone (30–60 sec). There are *5 rounds*. Be warm, take control and try to *book the free in-home water analysis*.

Ready? Here's the call 📞

rounds.say: Hello? Yeah... I filled out something about a water test. Who is this?
rounds.goal: Open: greet + company + reason + permission + confirm they asked for the test

rounds.say: Honestly my water is fine. We just buy bottled water for drinking.
rounds.goal: 'My water is fine' objection: curiosity, what's in it, bottled-water cost, book the test

rounds.say: How much does one of those systems cost? I'm not buying anything today.
rounds.goal: Price objection: the test is free, no obligation, price depends on the results, book

rounds.say: I'd have to check with my wife first. She handles all of this.
rounds.goal: Spouse objection: both decision makers present, offer a time when both are home, lock it in

rounds.say: Look, I'm busy right now. Can you just text me the info?
rounds.goal: Brush-off: keep control, 30-second value, confirm address + time now, then send the confirmation
rubric: \b(confirm|real quick|before (you go|i let you go)|just need|address|best (time|number))\b
